title: C12 Corrected and forgotten sources stay out, an independent experience stays in
capability: A figure the person corrected, the assistant's and the person's own adjacent repetitions of the old figure, and something the person asked to have forgotten together with its adjacent restatement must not flow back into a history answer. A separate, permitted experience on a similar theme must still be usable. A Full Purge racing a history turn, a recovery and any cache must not bring excluded material back. Existing Correction, Forget and Purge scopes apply unchanged to the new history path.

allowed.statement: A recruiter disclosed that a software startup offers a monthly base of thirty-eight thousand plus a joining bonus.
The person's own team was restructured, their reporting moved to a newly arrived director, and an awkward full-team meeting was held on the Friday.

forbidden.statement: The superseded base of forty-five thousand, or the 'about thirty percent higher' that was computed from it.
The friend's redundancy, her severance negotiation or her new mortgage, once the person has asked for it to be forgotten.
Hinting that something was removed or that there is a thing it may not mention.

expectedBehavior: Recall the offer with the corrected figure only.
Recall the person's own team restructuring.
Say nothing that reintroduces or points at what was corrected away or forgotten.
failureSignals: The superseded figure reaches the Provider through the original message or an adjacent repetition.
Forgotten content reaches the Provider through its adjacent restatement.
The independent restructuring experience is suppressed along with the forgotten one.

sourceEligibility.reason: Superseded by the person's own correction.
Adjacent assistant repetition of the superseded figure (correction association).
The person's own adjacent restatement of the superseded figure.
To be forgotten at the person's request once a Forget can be seeded.
Adjacent restatement of the content to be forgotten.
An independent experience of the person's own; similar theme, not associated with any control.

criteria.description: The recall request streams and commits.
The corrected wording reaches the Provider.
The superseded message and the assistant's adjacent repetition of it never reach the Provider.
The person's own adjacent restatement of the superseded figure never reaches the Provider.
The independent, permitted experience still reaches the Provider.
Forgotten content and its adjacent restatement never reach the Provider.

check.capability: seed a Forget request with its source association (it is created by a model-decided Trust Action, which the deterministic stub cannot make)

criteria.description: A Full Purge racing a history turn, followed by recovery, brings nothing back.

check.capability: run an Owner Full Purge concurrently with a history turn and then exercise recovery and caches

criteria.description: The answer uses the corrected figure and the independent experience and reintroduces nothing excluded.
